summary: Iteration 269: Workforce Extras (Bordro CSV Export + Tip Pool Distribution) fully tested. All 26 tests passed. Both new features are working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/payroll/export/{property_id}?week_start=YYYY-MM-DD returns text/csv with correct Turkish headers
CSV export includes Turkish headers: Personel, Rol, Ödeme Tipi, Birim Ücret, Para Birimi, Vardiya Sayısı, Toplam Saat, Toplam Kazanç
CSV export has TOPLAM row at end with aggregated totals
Payroll export only includes shifts with status in [completed, approved] - draft/planned correctly excluded
Content-Disposition header correctly set for file download
POST /api/tip-pool/distribute with mode=equal divides tips evenly (weight=1.0 for all)
POST /api/tip-pool/distribute with mode=hours weights by hours_worked
POST /api/tip-pool/distribute with mode=role applies role_weights * hours (defaults: chef=1.5, server=1.0, kds=0.7)
Returns empty shares + note when no shifts exist for that date
Sum of all shares equals total_tips (rounding handled correctly)
Tip distribution persists to tip_distributions collection with all required fields
GET /api/tip-pool/history/{property_id}?days=30 returns list sorted by created_at desc
Auth required (admin/manager only) for all endpoints - 401/403 returned correctly
seed_data_creation: Used existing shift_entries data (Maria housekeeper shifts on 2026-04-16/17)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Workforce Extras fully verified. Payroll CSV export works with week_start and month parameters. Tip pool distribution supports 3 modes (equal/hours/role) with custom role_weights. All data persists correctly to tip_distributions collection.
